validation.claim: The order is not assumed; it is forced by the field types.

The type list contains exactly one Boolean, at index 22 (last). The only boolean parameter is NoErosion.
The obfuscated suffixes 0x759..0x76f form a contiguous run of 23 values, matching the 23 declared fields; the 3 values absent from the call site (0x75d, 0x75f, 0x762) are simply not set by PE().

gapsInThisBuildImplementation.note: Parameters Gaea exposes for Erosion2 that web/js/registry.js does not implement. Listed because an unimplemented parameter is a behaviour difference, not a cosmetic one.

uiParameters.name: Duration
uiParameters.description: Controls how long erosion runs. Longer durations produce more elaborate terrain reshaping, while shorter durations help preserve original forms.

uiParameters.name: Downcutting
uiParameters.description: Governs how deeply water cuts into the terrain, carving valleys and channels.

uiParameters.name: Erosion Scale
uiParameters.description: Sets the overall size of erosion features, from fine gullies to massive ravines.

uiParameters.name: Seed
uiParameters.description: Randomizes the erosion pattern while keeping other settings the same.

uiParameters.name: Suspended Load
uiParameters.description: Fine, light sediments that travel far and fill gullies with subtle detail.

uiParameters.name: Discharge Angle
uiParameters.description: Sets the slope at which suspended load settles.

uiParameters.name: Bed Load
uiParameters.description: Heavier sediments like gravel that fill and shape gullies and slopes.

uiParameters.name: Discharge Angle
uiParameters.description: Sets the slope at which suspended load settles.

uiParameters.name: Coarse Sediments
uiParameters.description: The heaviest materials (boulders, scree) that deposit on steep slopes.

uiParameters.name: Discharge Angle
uiParameters.description: Sets the slope at which suspended load settles.

uiParameters.name: Shape
uiParameters.description: Enables artistic control over how erosion reshapes terrain.

uiParameters.name: Shape Sharpness
uiParameters.description: Defines how sharp or concave ridges become after erosion.

uiParameters.name: Shape Detail Scale
uiParameters.description: Sets the scale of simulated details, from broad ravines to fine gullies.

uiParameters.name: Enable
uiParameters.description: Toggles orographic influence on or off.

uiParameters.name: Directional Precipitation
uiParameters.description: Simulates rain falling more intensely from one direction to create rain shadows.

uiParameters.name: Direction
uiParameters.description: Sets the direction from which rainfall comes most strongly.

uiParameters.name: Rain Shadow
uiParameters.description: Controls how strongly terrain blocks rainfall from certain directions.

uiParameters.name: Slope
uiParameters.description: Limits rainfall effects to specific elevation ranges.

uiParameters.name: Altitude
uiParameters.description: Limits rainfall effects to specific slope ranges.

uiParameters.name: Reverse
uiParameters.description: Inverts the influence mask for creative control.

nodeVsKernel.note: Duplicate 'Discharge Angle' entries are distinguished only by position: each follows the load parameter it belongs to. Gaea's own descriptions for all three are identical, so the description cannot be used to tell them apart.
